scope: Posts and Pages responsive editor geometry plus a real 5,000-word publication guard; preserves v312 Theme/Members/Domain, v311 onboarding, and the existing Studio sidebar/Nara authorities.
notes: The editing surface now expands from content instead of reserving a 980px blank sheet for a new draft.
At 820px and above the writing surface and document inspector remain side by side; compact devices use one writing column with complete settings below.
The 5,000-word rule does not delete or truncate draft text. It only prevents publication until the draft is within the configured limit.
This release does not claim universal real-device perfection or extreme login capacity without measured production tests.
